name: Illes Foods
old_description: From marinades and seasonings, to beverage solutions and sauces, ILLES Foods provides custom-crafted culinary creations and R&D expertise to foodservice chains, food manufacturers, and grocery retailers.
about:
Illes Foods operates from Carrollton, Texas, drawing on nearly a century of experience in flavor development and food manufacturing. The company traces its roots back 97 years, built on values of integrity, curiosity, and partnership, though a specific founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces custom seasonings, sauces, marinades, and beverage solutions, offering a full range of manufacturing services for both liquid and dry products. Its capabilities extend to custom flavor creation, flavor development, packaging, and labeling, serving as a single-source partner for product commercialization.

Illes Foods serves foodservice chains, food manufacturers, and grocery retailers. Customers include national restaurant brands and retail suppliers who rely on the company's R&D and culinary teams for limited-time offers, core ingredients, and new product launches. Testimonials from procurement, R&D, and culinary leaders highlight long-term partnerships spanning 3 to 15 years.

The company differentiates itself with a "small enough to care, big enough to execute" philosophy, emphasizing trust, transparency, and results. Its core values—operating with integrity, staying intentionally curious, and believing in the power of partnership—guide decisions, and the team aims to function as an extension of its customers' own R&D and supply chain operations.
